subject: kimi-k3-in-c, run locally to test the storage-streamed inference hypothesis in clover-ai.md section 10

upstream.author: Fareed Khan
upstream.note: Clover claims no part of this work. Weights are Moonshot AI's and are not redistributed.

verified_here.claim: the engine builds clean from source
verified_here.evidence: make -j exit 0, no diagnostics, under -Wall -Wextra -Wpointer-arith -Wshadow -Wvla with warnings treated as failures

verified_here.claim: the engine matches its reference implementation
verified_here.evidence: make test: GATE 1 teacher forcing 32/32 and generated span 20/20; GATE 1b state reuse, all logits bit-identical; GATE 2 greedy decode 20/20; GATE 3 incremental 20/20 with KV cache and carried KDA state. ALL WEIGHTLESS TESTS PASSED
verified_here.scope: a 13-layer, hidden-128, vocab-256 oracle with the same tensor graph, 628 tensors. NOT the 2.78T checkpoint

verified_here.claim: the published expert-cache measurements reproduce independently
verified_here.evidence: tools/sim_cache.py replayed tests/fixtures/expert_trace.bin, a trace of 100,096 real expert requests recorded during a full 93-layer run

reproduced_figures.lru_hit_rate_8gb_to_64gb: flat 36.24% across an eightfold capacity increase
reproduced_figures.belady_hit_rate_8gb_to_64gb: 39.42% rising to 61.74% over the same range
reproduced_figures.compulsory_ceiling: 90.00% for any policy at any size on this trace

verified_here.why_it_matters: the flat-LRU / climbing-Belady gap is 25.5 points at identical memory, so the lever is replacement policy rather than capacity

not_established_here: that Kimi K3 was run; no weights were downloaded and no token was generated
tokenizer parity, which the suite reported as not run because it needs tiktoken.model from the checkpoint
any storage-bandwidth or seconds-per-token figure, all of which are upstream's measurements on their hardware
scripts/k3-doctor.sh, which is Linux-only and declined to run on Windows

blocked_on_resources.requirement: approximately 1.7 TB of fast local disk: a 1.56 TB checkpoint plus a 109 GB packed trunk
blocked_on_resources.note: this is a storage gate, not a memory gate. The ultra preset lowers RAM to about 3 GB; the bytes must still exist locally because the design streams them rather than holding them. RAM here (15.7 GB) already clears the 8 GB floor
blocked_on_resources.also_needed: a HuggingFace token, and a download upstream describes as hours rather than minutes

what_this_changes_for_clover.hypothesis_tested: clover-ai.md section 10 lists storage-streamed inference as an experiment, comparing RAM-resident against RAM+NVMe against storage-streamed
what_this_changes_for_clover.finding_from_upstream_data: the sharper claim is allocation rather than streaming. Upstream measured the expert cache doing nothing below roughly 36 GB of arena, and giving that memory to the trunk instead was 1.69x faster at identical total budget
what_this_changes_for_clover.status: engine verified locally; the measurement that would test the hypothesis on our own workload still needs the checkpoint
